Resources.PreviewOnly: Local images are preview-only. Select an engine-imported texture to assign; local paths are never used as engine asset references.
Resources.InvalidImage: Select a valid PNG or JPEG with dimensions up to 8192 × 8192.
Resources.FileTooLarge: Resource previews are limited to 16 MiB.
Resources.FileChanged: The preview file changed while reading. Refresh and select it again.
Resources.GroupChanged: The selected Group library changed. Select the resource again.
Resources.SelectTarget: Multiple compatible targets exist. Explicitly select a target; no first-target assignment is performed.
Resources.NoTarget: Select a compatible render node or GPU texture resource. Material assets can be inspected but cannot replace material slots here.
Resources.TargetReady: The selected target will be updated as one undoable edit.
Resources.LoadDetails: Wait for details from the selected engine before assigning.
